summary: Customer requests written confirmation that an NIR system will measure granulate moisture to ±0.1 % and that a regulator will approve it for release testing, plus price for the complete system before ordering.

facts_stated.text: Customer refers to an NIR system.
Customer wants moisture measured in their granulate.
Customer wants regulator approval for release testing.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: our regulator will approve it for release testing

facts_stated.text: Customer requests the price of the complete system.

targets.enquiry_quote: measure the moisture of our granulate to plus or minus 0.1 %

customer_premises.claim: The NIR system is suitable for measuring moisture in the customer's granulate.
The NIR system can achieve ±0.1 % moisture accuracy.
A vendor can guarantee that the customer's regulator will approve the NIR system for release testing.
customer_premises.enquiry_quote: guarantee that our regulator will approve it for release testing

customer_premises.claim: A complete system can be specified and priced before measurement requirements and sample/process details are established.
Written confirmation before order is sufficient evidence of method suitability.

unknowns: Moisture range and expected variation in the granulate.
Whether ±0.1 % is absolute percentage points or relative error.
Granulate composition, particle size, bulk density, and sample presentation.
Optical behaviour of the granulate in the NIR region, including scattering and absorption.
Installation point, interface to the process, and required standoff or fiber distance.
Temperature, pressure, vibration, and hazardous-area requirements at the measurement point.
Required response time and measurement frequency.
Reference method and validation protocol for release testing.
Regulatory jurisdiction and specific approval requirements.
Calibration model development, maintenance, and transfer across batches or sites.
Scope of the complete system price, including hardware, software, installation, and validation.
